data.title: BNPL Cross-Account Device Clustering
data.description: Detects four or more distinct BNPL accounts created from or accessed by the same device fingerprint within a 30-day window, indicating potential synthetic identity ring activity or account farming operations. Normal BNPL usage involves 1-2 accounts per device over 12 months. Emulator-based mass account opening tools with device fingerprint spoofing can create dozens of accounts per day from a single physical device, but sophisticated device fingerprinting systems can detect emulator signatures and fingerprint collision patterns. This rule supports TP-0040 Phase 3 detection by identifying device-level clustering that precedes multi-provider stacking and coordinated bust-out.
falsepositives: Shared household devices used by multiple family members for individual BNPL accounts
Retail kiosk or shared terminal devices in store environments
Workplace devices used by employees for personal BNPL accounts
